clips.title: The story
paras: Above Darkshire, Viktori Prism'Antras keeps his gaze on the stars.

Up the slope beyond the gryphon roost, Viktori Prism'Antras peers out from Duskwood's gloom. Undead incursions, ravenous spiders, and creeping shadows surround him, but his attention is fixed beyond the suffocating canopy. He hopes to build a fine optical telescope that will bring the stars into clear focus, giving him a quiet refuge from the dread engulfing the hamlet.

In this cursed forest, even a delicate telescope takes work to build. Viktori follows blueprints from his gnomish friend, Cog Glitzspinner. He asks passersby to find rare lens-crafting materials and mechanical housings, including finely cut glass and metal lenses scattered across perilous ground.
